description: Elections Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of member the kalawana Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Kalawana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the procedural steps following a failure to take an oath of office and the subsequent nomination by a political party. The core subject is an electoral process at the local government level, which fits the definition of **Elections Gazettes (Type 7)** concerning candidate nominations and declarations to fill vacancies.
